acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark crescent-shaped lesion on the upper back and several white linear rake marks or scars on the mid-to-lower back.
other_distinctive_markers: The highly unique, dark crescent-shaped mark on the anterior dorsal region is the primary identifying feature.
